search_row.title: Neutral substitution rate equals the mutation rate
search_row.statement: For neutral mutations the long-run rate of molecular substitution equals the mutation rate per generation, independent of population size, which yields a molecular clock.

fields.dct:source: Motoo Kimura (1968) Evolutionary Rate at the Molecular Level
fields.delphi:proposedTest: Compare the substitution rate at putatively neutral sites (synonymous sites, pseudogenes) across lineages with independently measured per-generation mutation rates from pedigree sequencing.
fields.delphi:context: Assumptions: strictly neutral mutations, mutation rate constant per generation, steady state. Formal status: an exact consequence of the neutral fixation probability. Variation in generation time and weak selection on nearly neutral sites cause departures from strict clock-like rates.
